race.comment: EVER SO READY (9) bounced off his narrow third first up, with a sharp win as favourite over 1015m at this track. Back in great order and can keep the winning momentum going. IL FRATELLO (7) lightly raced gelding kept fresh for this after resuming with a sound third over 1000m at the Gold Coast. Since fitted with a 1000m trial and stays in the calculations. DIZZY DEE (1) pushed forward from a wide draw and covered plenty of ground in the run with a tiring seventh over 1106m at this track. Claim helps and likely to roll forward from the gate. Minor claims best. VENDEMMIA (4) holding his form and saves his best for this track. Snagged back from the wide gate and made up good ground late to run third over 1410m at this track. Tempo suits and keep safe.
